sourcePin: Parent final-ready, no subsequent source edits reported; hashes below are the reviewed state.
summary: GKT131 reuse with existing Spring/pgvector HNSW and shared Top50 cache is a coherent low-cost local design. Public API defaults and response shape are preserved; team representation/schema/auth migration and all runtime validation remain unexecuted.

documentChecks.subject: Preservation
documentChecks.detail: Five original numeric/configuration JSON files retain exact before.json SHA256; only scoped Markdown integrations and two new design files differ.

documentChecks.subject: Architecture and cost
documentChecks.detail: Reuse of the existing pgvector contract avoids a new ANN dependency or online model. One bounded miss search, shared cache, optional bounded prewarm, and no full all-pairs prerequisite are explicit.

documentChecks.subject: Vector and score semantics
documentChecks.detail: Frozen 131-dimensional float64 source remains authoritative for its original group contract. Similar-movie scoring explicitly uses the separate float32 cosine copy and requires its own future tolerance check. sub_supported is independent of group membership.

documentChecks.subject: Candidate and authorization rules
documentChecks.detail: Base access check and candidate public-evidence gate are distinct. User exclusions are applied after the public cache; authentication failure cannot silently become anonymous. Short results are allowed without unrelated fillers.

documentChecks.subject: pgvector query design
documentChecks.detail: Version partition and candidate-only partial cosine HNSW are specified. Raw distance ASC LIMIT is retained, ef_search and statement timeout are local to a transaction, iterative scans are off when supported, and LIMIT is not claimed as a graph-work bound.

documentChecks.subject: Versioning and failure
documentChecks.detail: Similarity input changes use immutable versions; unrelated public-number updates may reuse the index. Deactivation is checked at return time. Empty support states are distinct from failure; concurrency, queue, and retry limits are explicit.

documentChecks.subject: API, reasons and events
documentChecks.detail: API-031 default 10/max 20 and card response remain; reasons use actual shared genres or generic content wording. Similar lists neither create recommendation IDs/sets nor change viewed/rating/inputVersion state.

documentChecks.subject: Evaluation scope
documentChecks.detail: Exact comparison is limited to fixed query samples, uses identical eligibility/self/dedup/positive filters, compares final ANN Top10 only, accepts boundary ties, excludes N/A from the equal-query mean, and separates retrieval recall from human content relevance.

documentChecks.subject: Implementation status
documentChecks.detail: Local design approval is separated from the team E5 representation contract, migration, code, index construction, S01-S08 execution, latency claims, and content-quality claims.

resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Both paths share filters; only sorted final ANN Top10 is compared with the tie-expanded exact answer set. Denominator and equal-query averaging are explicit.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Fallback reason could overclaim keyword/overview contribution
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Without shared genre, the summary is generic content similarity with empty factors; block support alone is not treated as positive evidence.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Unrelated catalog updates could force unnecessary HNSW rebuild
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Similarity version changes track actual content/eligible-set/mapping/recipe inputs; original sourceCatalogVersion stays historical when an index is reused.

linkValidation.scope: Relative Markdown target-file existence; external destinations and heading fragments are not claimed as automatically validated.

references.usedFor: Official cosine storage, HNSW settings/filtering/index-plan semantics; these are design references, not evidence of a deployed index.
Genres/keywords scope of the alternative API; no API request was sent.
